text:
laura: Heads up, ap-southeast1 GPU attach queue is seeing a big stall, looks correlated with local scratch IOPS collapse on a cohort of hosts.
raj: seeing it too, attaching jobs time out around 30s then retry. GPU provisioning backlog +120.
laura: metrics: avg write iops for affected scratch pool fell from ~180k -> ~22k at 02:12 UTC. Read latency jumped 6x.
storage-sre: digging logs now, first pass shows janitor scrub tasks ramped up and started heavy fsyncs on 6k hosts. Possibly overlap with nightly cleaner window.
tom: any evidence of bitrot/corruption? customer-facing errors?
laura: not seeing fsck errors, but a couple of ephemeral mounts remounted read-only. We did have a firmware reset on one host around same time.
raj: ops-bot, can you post the recent deploys?
ops-bot: Deploy bot: no storage-related deploys between 01:30-02:30 UTC. Kernel patch rolled to control-plane at 00:50.
mike: hypothesis: scrub + firmware reset caused write buffer thrash causing IOPS starvation for attach flow. Attach needs quick metadata writes; with queue depth saturated it times out.
storage-sre: confirmed: janitor concurrency jumped 5x due to a scheduler bug, scrub heartbeat didn't notice backpressure. Index: scrub_concurrency=40 -> 200.
laura: immediate mitigations?
raj: 1) throttle janitor (reduce concurrency) 2) mark affected scratch pools as low-priority for attach routing 3) start draining worst hosts and reprovision.
storage-sre: executing throttle now: set SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=48 on ap-southeast1 janitor fleet. Patching in progress.
laura: priority: free up attach capacity first, then roll hosts. Cost tradeoff: if we route attaches to hotter (larger) instances or to eu hosts we'll incur inter-region egress + infra cost. estimate rough delta ~$3k/hr if we shift 30% of attaches to hosted fallback.
mike: for immediate relief, can we bump attach timeout to avoid flapping? tends to mask root cause but reduces churn.
raj: prefer avoid masking. throttle and drain first. Also schedule canary of scrub fix in 30m.
storage-sre: scrub throttle applied at 02:25 UTC. early signs: iops trending up, attach backlog down ~40%.
laura: good. Ops checklist for next 6 hours: 1) finish host drains (migrate 120 stuck attaches) 2) run small canary of scrub scheduler patch in staging 3) patch firmware on hosts that reset 4) postmortem with timelines.
storage-sre: note: we saw 3 hosts with SMART attr change (194/195) during the event; added to remediation list.
mike: ping @platform-team to delay non-critical batch jobs for next 4 hours in ap-southeast1.
raj: can someone open a ticket for cost approval if we need cross-region fallback? tag: #finance-notify.
laura: I'll file ticket and link runbook. Thanks team, will post updates as drains finish. :thumbsup:
storage-sre: update 02:54 UTC: drain progress 60/120 hosts, attach backlog down to +42. Continuing.
